about: Local corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build_resort.py for Isola 2000. No official piste list has been checked yet, so names and colours are as mapped in OSM; only obvious spelling variants are merged.

acceptNearGaps.why: Same rule as Saint-Lary: piste ends that miss the next piste by at most 30 m are treated as connected.

looseEndRadiusWhy: Chevrette stops mid-slope in OSM (2095 m, past the Combe Grosse crossing) with nothing within 200 m below it. With 500 m the build connects it to Sierra at the same altitude, which then continues down; the connection is an estimate.
